BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.
   B. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.
   C. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

3. Which statement about Foreign Exchange Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Foreign Exchange Markets.
   B. Say Foreign Exchange Markets never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Foreign Exchange Markets as rumours only.
   D. Explain Foreign Exchange Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.

5. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   C. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   D. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.
   B. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.
   D. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

8. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.
   D. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Insurance as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.

10. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   B. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   C. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.
   B. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.
   C. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Networking in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Income Statement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
